    bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]

        marked = any(grid[rr][cc] == 5 for rr in range(r+1,end) for cc in range(len(row)))
        sections.append((color,height,marked))
    return [[color if c < height//2 else 0 for c in range(3)] + [9, 5 if marked else 0] for color,height,marked in sections]
'''

    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0, 9)]

        length = (object_height + 1) // 2
